top_story_headline: SlowMist uncovers macOS malware that steals Telegram sessions and swaps Ledger, Trezor apps for phishing loaders
top_story_comment: Yer 2FA didn't fail — the malware copied yer already-authenticated Telegram session file and walked in without ever asking for yer code. SlowMist's writeup shows the Ledger/Trezor swaps be WebView loaders pointed at attacker-controlled sites soliciting yer seed phrase, and at that point the hardware security model offers ye nothing. 🦑
